CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY -----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Purnendu Sharan, Advocate For the State : Mr. Saket Kumar, A.P.P.
-----
Oral Order 03 / Dated : 21.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner named above has been made accused in connection with Godda (M) Motiya O.P. P.S. Case No. 230 of 2022 for the offence under Sections 498A, 302, 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3, 4 of D.P. Act.

entities.text: Motiya O.P. P.S. Case No. 230 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
As per the prosecution case, the deceased is the wife of the petitioner and she sustained ante-mortem injury including bruises over her body and the cause of death has been stated to be probably shock and asphyxia due to strangulation.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that it was not a case of homicide but case of suicide and the dead body was recovered from a closed room which was broken open by the brother-in-law of the deceased along with the petitioner.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that there are allegations of dowry demand and assault and it was not a case of suicide but a case of homicide as per the postmortem report.
Further, independent witnesses have stated that the petitioner used to assault the deceased.
Considering the gravity of offence, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly,
his prayer for bail is hereby rejected.
